# korean-word-of-the-day — a static Korean word-of-the-day resting screen

## What it is

A resting screen for a wall panel, tablet, or spare monitor: one Korean word a day, plus a Korean word clock that spells the time the way Koreans actually say it. Two static files, `index.html` and `words.js`. No build step, no API, no keys, no network calls, no tracking. Open `index.html` and it works, including with the internet down.

The word bank is stored in a global `window.KOREAN_WORDS` array. Each word entry has a `ko` field for Hangul, the hero glyph line; a `roman` field for Revised Romanization of the whole word; a `sound` field that is deliberately different from `roman` to show actual pronunciation; a `pos` field for part of speech, shown after "Means ·"; a `meaning` field for the definition line; a `syl` field with per-syllable `[hangul, roman]` pairs for the "Syllables" block; and an `ex` field with `[korean, english]` example sentences for the "In use" block.

Rotation of words is deterministic by date, with no API, tokens, or network involved. Index 0 is 설레다 so day one matches the approved mockup exactly. The hero line auto-shrinks past 4 syllables, but the design breathes best at 2–3 syllables.

## Why it exists

The product provides a passive, offline Korean learning surface for a wall-mounted display. It exists to show one Korean word a day with its romanization, pronunciation, meaning, syllables, and example sentence, plus a word clock that renders the current time as a spoken Korean phrase. Without it, the resting screen would have no content.

## How it is used

- **Owner:** opens `index.html` in any browser; for a kiosk, points the kiosk browser at the file or at the repo's GitHub Pages URL at 1280×800 or similar.
- **Agent:** runs `node tests/test_korean_pin.js` for behavioral tests of the date-pin logic.
- **Automatic consumers:** none — no API, no tables, no ports, no env keys, no systemd units.

## Boundaries

- **Owns:** the word bank (`window.KOREAN_WORDS`), the deterministic date-based rotation, the word clock, and the date-pin logic.
- **Never does:** never makes network calls — the product is fully offline by design; never requires a build step — two static files, open and run; never tracks users — no analytics, no keys, no tokens.
- **Escalates to owner:** any change to the word bank shape — the shape mirrors exactly what the Resting Screen design renders, so adding a word is data-only, never a layout change; any change to the rotation algorithm — rotation is deterministic by date and index 0 is 설레다 so day one matches the approved mockup exactly.
- **Owner:** `UNKNOWN (fact not harvested)`.
